glosses: flesh, the soft part of a body which covers the bones
an animal’s meat, or by extension the edible “fleshy” or soft part of a fruit or vegetable

examples.text: Tom sólo come carnes magras y verduras.
examples.en: Tom only eats lean meats and vegetables.

examples.text: Si quieres evitar el colesterol, come carnes magras sin grasa.
examples.en: If you want to avoid cholesterol, eat lean meat with no fat.
